boundaries: Native Slate event injection is not physical USB gamepad hardware certification.
The two MMORPG tutorial abilities use ServerOnly instant activation; the reusable ASC matches dynamic spec tags, while held/released queues and local prediction remain an explained extension.
Training packaged acceptance covers its eleven single-player checks. Two-player networking, overlap pickup and respawn have separately recorded native PIE evidence.

The first Training packaged run logged an AudioMixer queue diagnostic. A second run of the same executable passed without Error/Stall and retained one underrun Display. First-run task timing is a hypothesis, not a proven root cause; sound quality and frame-time performance are not certified. The untouched published screenshot belongs to the first run and retains its startup warning.
The first MMORPG slice is one region, one dedicated server and two clients, not a production sharded MMO or load-test certification.
Official Lyra/template content and third-party binaries are prepared locally from the recorded sources; they are not bundled as original tutorial assets.
A full installation and replay on a second clean Windows host was not performed.
